summary.business_type: SaaS — static hosting for AI-generated websites
top_findings: Sitemap lists www + .html URLs; all 9 entries are 2-hop 301 chains and robots.txt points to the www sitemap
Canonical tags missing on 6 of 9 pages; the 3 present point to redirecting .html URLs
Homepage has no structured data despite a 4-tier pricing table and feature grid
No gzip/brotli compression on HTML, CSS (123 KB) or JS; unused critical-CSS build never inlined
Prompt Library content is email-gated and JS-injected, invisible to Google and AI crawlers
No per-tool deploy pages, comparison pages, About page, or social proof; competitors own the target SERPs
quick_wins: Replace sitemap.xml with sitemap-corrected.xml and fix robots.txt Sitemap line
Add clean-URL canonical and og:url to all 9 pages
Enable encode zstd gzip in Caddy
Paste generated Organization/WebSite/SoftwareApplication JSON-LD into homepage
Re-export og-image.png (1.5 MB) and two blog hero PNGs (2.7 MB each) as compressed WebP

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Internal links already use clean extensionless URLs with no 404s
Content fully present in raw HTML; no JS rendering dependency
HTTP/2, correct viewport, lang, favicon set
Assets served with cache-control: public
robots.txt open to all crawlers

findings.title: Sitemap URLs all redirect (www + .html)
findings.description: All 9 sitemap URLs use https://www.ezlaunch.app/*.html; each 301s to apex then to the extensionless path. robots.txt Sitemap directive also points to www.
findings.recommendation: Deploy sitemap-corrected.xml (apex host, clean URLs) and update robots.txt to https://ezlaunch.app/sitemap.xml.

findings.title: Canonical tags missing or pointing to redirects
findings.description: Home, contact, privacy, prompt-library, status, terms have no canonical. Blog index and both posts canonicalize to .html URLs that 301.
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel="canonical"> with clean https://ezlaunch.app URLs to all 9 pages; align og:url.

findings.title: No HTTP compression on text assets
findings.description: HTML, styles.css (123,506 B) and JS return no content-encoding even with Accept-Encoding: gzip, br.
findings.recommendation: Add `encode zstd gzip` to the Caddy site block.

findings.title: Render-blocking 123 KB stylesheet; critical CSS unused
findings.description: css/critical-index.css and css/critical-sub.css exist in the repo but are referenced by no page.
findings.recommendation: Inline the critical CSS per page type and defer styles.css.

findings.title: Missing HSTS, CSP, Permissions-Policy
findings.description: Only x-content-type-options, x-frame-options, referrer-policy are set. Third-party scripts (Meta Pixel) load without a CSP.
findings.recommendation: Add Strict-Transport-Security, a Content-Security-Policy allow-list, and Permissions-Policy in Caddy.

findings.title: Meta Pixel loaded twice
findings.description: js/meta-pixel.js in body plus an inline snippet in the served head fire PageView twice.
findings.recommendation: Keep a single loader.

findings.title: CSS/JS cached 24h without hashed filenames
findings.description: Short TTL with no cache-busting.
findings.recommendation: Hash filenames and set max-age=31536000, immutable.

findings.title: /llms.txt missing; no IndexNow
findings.description: Both 404 / absent.
findings.recommendation: Publish llms.txt (draft in findings/geo.md) and an IndexNow key.

findings.title: x-middleware-rewrite header leaks routing
findings.description: Response exposes /api/serve/custom/index.html.
findings.recommendation: Strip the header at Caddy.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Deploy post is 2,090 words with a comparison table, byline and date
Pricing is transparent on the homepage
Blog heroes have descriptive alt text

findings.title: Prompt Library content gated and uncrawlable
findings.description: 119 crawlable words; prompts injected by JS after email capture. Title/meta promise content Google never sees.
findings.recommendation: Render prompt titles, summaries and several full prompts in HTML; gate only the download.

findings.title: No social proof
findings.description: No testimonials, logos, case studies or usage numbers anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Add real counts, 2-3 testimonials and customer logos to the homepage.

findings.title: No About or team page
findings.description: Company identity appears only in legal pages as Jaguar Hosting LLC, Wyoming.
findings.recommendation: Create /about with founder, mission, contact channels; link from footer.

findings.title: Status page shows stale hardcoded date
findings.description: "Last updated: May 2026" on a page claiming real-time status.
findings.recommendation: Wire to live data or remove the date.

findings.title: Posts lack author bio, updated date, dateModified
findings.description: Visible byline and publish date only.
findings.recommendation: Add author bios with links and an Updated date; set dateModified in schema.

findings.title: Homepage lacks a citable product definition
findings.description: Only the meta description states what EZLaunch is; visible copy is card microcopy.
findings.recommendation: Add a 2-3 sentence entity-first paragraph near the top.

findings.title: Thin blog index and status pages
findings.description: 173 and 103 words respectively.
findings.recommendation: Add category intro copy and post excerpts to the blog index.

findings.title: Canonical missing on 6 pages

findings.title: Blog index og:title mismatch

findings.title: meta keywords present

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList, Blog/CollectionPage, ContactPage

findings.title: No text compression

findings.recommendation: Enable brotli/gzip in Caddy.

findings.title: Render-blocking full stylesheet
findings.description: 123.5 KB CSS blocks first paint on every page.
findings.recommendation: Inline the existing critical CSS and defer the rest.

findings.title: 2.6-2.7 MB PNG hero images on blog posts
findings.description: Likely LCP element on post pages.
findings.recommendation: WebP/AVIF at rendered size, srcset, fetchpriority=high.

findings.title: Meta Pixel double-fires
findings.description: Two loaders per page.
findings.recommendation: Remove one.

findings.title: Short cache TTL on CSS/JS without hashing
findings.description: 24h cache, no cache-busting.
findings.recommendation: Hashed filenames with immutable long TTL.

findings.title: Blog hero PNGs 2.77 MB and 2.73 MB

findings.title: og-image.png 1.5 MB

findings.title: Blog index thumbnails empty alt
